stories.title: Key leaders sound the alarm on AI. And, Iran-Gulf diplomacy hits a setback
stories.description: Some key leaders at artificial intelligence companies call for a slowdown in AI development. And, Iran-Gulf diplomacy hits a setback as talks in Oman are delayed.

stories.title: Morning news brief
stories.description: Industry leaders call for AI development to slow down to ensure safety, Trump to campaign for GOP candidates ahead of midterms, Iranian officials say a meeting with the Gulf States has been postponed.

stories.title: Talks between Iran and Gulf states to discuss Strait of Hormuz postponed
stories.description: Iranian officials say a meeting with Gulf states to discuss the Strait of Hormuz has been postponed, dealing a blow to efforts to reopen the strait.

stories.title: World leaders gathered for the annual BRICS summit. Here are the takeaways
stories.description: India hosted the an annual summit which gathered leaders from 28 countries, including the presidents of China and Iran. Though, the U.S. was notably absent.

stories.title: Can Gulf states and Iran negotiate the Strait of Hormuz without the U.S.?
stories.description: Dania Thafer of the Gulf International Forum weighs in on previously scheduled talks between Iran and Gulf states. Shortly before this interview aired, Oman announced that the talks were postponed.

stories.title: US pilot shot down over Iran recalls 'free-falling' in first interview since rescue
stories.description: The April rescue operation to recover the downed aircrew saw the first US boots on the ground in Iran in 46 years, American officials say.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq
stories.description: Iraq removes a military commander and opens investigations into the attack that came from an area bordering Iran.

stories.title: Lightning Houthi advance in Yemen may bring dangerous new dimension to Iran war
stories.description: The capture by the rebels of a stretch of Yemen's strategic coastline is the group's most impressive military coup for several years.

stories.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
stories.description: The Iran-backed Houthis are also reported to have seized Perim - a strategic island on the major shipping route.

stories.title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
stories.description: The powerful blast registered as the equivalent of a magnitude 4.1 earthquake, according to the US Geological Survey.

stories.title: Yemen's Houthis seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
stories.description: Mokha's capture brings the Iran-backed group closer to controlling a key international shipping route.

stories.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
stories.description: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.

stories.title: How a community living under demolition orders from Israel view UK sanctions
stories.description: BBC's Middle East Correspondent Lucy Williamson visits the Palestinian community of Khan al Ahmar in the so-called E1 area, and the neighbouring Israeli settlement of Maale Admumim.

stories.title: Iran referred to UN Security Council for nuclear non-compliance
stories.description: Tehran condemns the resolution, blaming US and Israeli strikes on its nuclear facilities for disrupting inspections.

stories.title: Muted US response to UK's West Bank sanctions may reflect simmering frustration
stories.description: The UK accuses Israel's government of turning a blind eye to the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians by settlers.

stories.title: JD Vance insists US is ‘on top of’ Houthi advance in Red Sea
stories.description: US Vice President JD Vance says the Trump administration is “very much on top of” the Houthi advance in Yemen.

stories.title: Why Middle East tensions are pushing oil prices above $100
stories.description: Brent crude has risen above $100 a barrel as war in Iran disrupts shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Fiscal pressure from Iran War clouds Gulf States’ US spending plans
stories.description: Gulf nations may prioritise domestic investments over US commitments amid economic pressures, says new report.

stories.description: “I will determine whether or not the U.S.A. will choose to engage, the concept of which we are open to," Mr. Trump said on his Truth Social network.

stories.title: Saudi oil pipeline hit in strikes will be mostly out of service for several weeks for repair
